newsitem.title: UK: UK's Millennium picks John Laing, McAlpine.
newsitem.headline: UK's Millennium picks John Laing, McAlpine.

text.p: Britain's grand plan to celebrate the millennium moved further ahead on Friday, naming building firms John Laing Plc and Sir Robert McAlpine as construction managers for the project, subject to contract.
Millennium Central said it picked the firms' venture to manage construction of the Greenwich Millennium Exhibition, a two-year exhibit to be built in London at ground zero of the world's time zones.
Construction work on the project, which will encompass the arts, science, history and sport, will start in July.
More than 2,500 jobs will be created on and off-site during the construction phase of the project, Millennium Central said in a statement.
The world sets its clocks in relation to Greenwich Mean Time following an 1884 international convention that put Greenwich on zero longitude.
